The Feast of Winter Veil, also called the feast of Great-Winter, or simply Winter Veil or Winter's Veil, is an in-game, end-of-year, several week long holiday event seeming to be the in-game counterpart of Christmas and other holidays at the end of the year. From the World of Warcraft calendar: Greatfather Winter is visiting the cities of Ironforge and Orgrimmar, courtesy of Smokywood Pastures. And throughout Azeroth, it is the season to be jolly!

Fear Kiting is a Warlock combat technique. It involves using the Fear spell on an enemy, casting damaging spells on the enemy and then, when the fear runs out, casting Fear on them again to repeat the process. This technique allows the Warlock to use damage over time spells or spells with long casting times that he/she normally would not be able to when in close combat. A skilled Warlock can keep an opponent "feared" so that the opponent can't even get one hit in. This technique does have its limitations though, particularly in PvP. The opponent may use a trinket or racial trait to undo the fear effect or may have a spell which has given them resistance or immunity to fear. Also in patch 2.2

Fear and Flesh is a book looted from a Corrupted Chest after completing any Corrupted or Lost area in the Vision of Stormwind or Vision of Orgrimmar. It was written by an adherent of N'Zoth and, like The Curse of Stone, serves as Old God propaganda. This book follows the cultist viewpoint that flesh is a generous gift from the Old Gods, not a curse. Wrathion notes that this idea is insidious because it contains a kernel of truth: "There is something to be said for the joy that comes with feeling the sun on one's skin and the wind in one's hair." However, the book neglects to mention any of the other effects of Old God corruption, or the suffering that N'Zoth's plans would bring.

Fel Creep is found while collecting herbs in Felwood while in possession of a Cenarion Beacon. It is an objective for the quest Salve via Gathering.
Fel Fire is provided as an objective for Kroshius' Infernal Core (quest).
Fel-Tinged Mantle drops from Vexallus in Magisters' Terrace.
The Fel Cone Fungus is located around Nazzivian in Bloodmyst Isle.
Fel Conquerer Raiments is an epic cloth chest armor for DPS casters.
After killing Grand Warlock Nethekurse he will drop a Grand Warlock's Amulet. You can then use this amulet at one of the two braziers near his seat to capture a Fel Ember.
Feeding Frenzy is a pet talent located in the 4th tier of the Cunning tree.
Fei Fei's Cache can be found in Honor Hold in Hellfire Peninsula, but only after Fei Fei reveals it.
The Fel-Tainted Morsels are provided as an objective for Little Morsels.
Fel Healthstones are created with a warlock's Create Healthstone (Rank 8) or Ritual of Souls (Rank 2) spell.
Feegly's Shroud is a quest reward from Feegly the Exiled (quest).
Feezle Spinspark is a level 17 engineering vendor located at the Northern Rocketway Exchange.
Feena Simplesap is a goblin poison vendor located in Bilgewater Harbor in Azshara. She can be found inside the inn on the first floor.
Fel Cannons: Fear are fel cannons found in Forge Camp Fear in Nagrand.
Fel Cannons: Hate are fel cannons found in Forge Camp Hate in Nagrand.
The Feeding Pits can be found on the southwest corner of Sra'vess, itself off the western coast of Townlong Steppes. The Sra'thik swarm of mantid keep Ravenous Kunchong in the pit.
This item is retrieved from the corpse of Feero Ironhand. Sentinel Onaeya wishes to return it to the Argent Dawn embassy in Darnassus.
Feeling Thorny wants you to go to speak with Auld Stonespire.
The Fel Imp is a demonic minion, available at level 75. It is unlocked by the talent Grimoire of Supremacy (original warlock talent) and replaces the Imp.
